{{Quote|You will recall, my lord, that following your announcement that the war had been won, Fang Zar and several other signatories of the Petition of the Two Thousand were briefly detained for questioning by Internal Security Bureau officers.|[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="DL" />}}
The '''Internal Security Bureau''' (abbreviated '''ISB''') was a internal intelligence and security organization of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DL" /> It was established in the wake of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> to protect [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s new authoritarian regime against political opponents and ideological dissidents.<ref name="DL" /> The Internal Security Bureau was the forerunner to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
{{Imp-stub}}
